This is Mr ADEOYE ,the husband of late BUNMI AKINNANU ADEOYE.(Omije ojumi)

January 30 2 min read Latunde Akin

This is Mr ADEOYE ,the husband of late BUNMI AKINNANU ADEOYE.(Omije ojumi)
Marriage is a junction where both God and Satan is interested at propagating their kingdom. So the need to also prepare for war as a good soldier of Christ.
Whatever happened between them, nobody knows. But I realized that Omije ojumi wasn't buried with his husband's name. Which means they have probably divorced or they absconded from one another for a long time.
Definitely they didn't make peace with each other till she left the world. And now the children are disoriented which showed clearly during the burial.
Why do some men treat women so badly?
Why do some women live with so much wound in their heart without healing?
I can testify that arrows of demonic sickness can't work if there's no wound already in the heart and mind of any targets. Get that fact.
People, please forgive everyone that has hurt you so much. Please forgive them o, I say again please forgive them for your own good. They don't have to repent before you forgive them in your heart. Don't claim even God doesn't forgive without repentance. You are not God o. God is God,man is man,the distance and comparison is irreconcilable.
What arrow of affliction is feeding on is your wound that has not been healed. Please quickly seek healing if you have been badly hurt by anyone. They enemy will not get you o. Amen
It is now I understand one the real reason why demonic arrow works against people and possibly kpai them. Unsettled quarrels is very key to the enemy having legal ground against anyone.
Yes, you can divorce and remain unmarried. But please never nurse bitterness or encourage it around your children.
Settle every dispute, follow peace of mind. Don't hate anyone who once hurt you. Don't build up on past discord.
We learn every day.
Goodnight Omije Ojumi.
May God minister to all parties concerned so peace can reign in the life of the children. In Jesus name. Amen
